title: Final Review
subtitle: Review everything you have, what is still missing, and what to bring to your appointment.

hero.attentionNone: Nothing is waiting for your attention

summary.title: Application summary
summary.description: The cover sheet of your dossier — the facts exactly as you recorded them.

checklist.title: Submission checklist
checklist.description: What you hand over, grouped the way it goes into the folder. Every status comes from your Documents workspace.
checklist.notCreated: Not added to your dossier yet
checklist.empty: There are no documents in your dossier yet.
checklist.emptyHint: Add your country pack's requirements in the Documents workspace and they will appear here.

attentionEmpty.title: Nothing needs attention
attentionEmpty.body: All applicable checklist items are confirmed ready.

attention.title: Still needs your attention
attention.description: Open findings from the consistency checks, most important first. Resolving these is the highest-value thing you can do before submitting.
attention.none: Nothing is waiting for your attention right now.
attention.noneHint: The consistency checks found nothing to resolve in the information you have entered so far.
attention.notesHint: Informational notes are worth reading, but nothing about them is wrong.

appointmentPrep.title: Appointment preparation
appointmentPrep.description: An organisational view of the day. VisaFlow does not know the office's procedure and never invents one.

beforeLeaving.title: Before leaving home
beforeLeaving.description: The things worth checking while you can still do something about them.

atAppointment.title: At the appointment
atAppointment.description: What you recorded about the appointment itself.

appointmentPrep.noAppointmentDetails: You have not recorded a time, location or confirmation number for this appointment yet.
appointmentPrep.noAppointment: No appointment recorded yet. Add one in the Trip workspace and this section will fill in.

afterSubmission.title: After you submit
afterSubmission.body: VisaFlow's role ends when your dossier is ready. It does not submit your application, track its progress, or receive any decision — nothing here leaves your device. What happens after you hand your documents over is between you and the office that received them.

appointmentPrep.notesTitle: Notes recorded for this country pack

print.title: Print package
print.description: Two different things, never blended: the pages VisaFlow can generate from what you recorded, and the folder of your own documents that only you can assemble.

generated.title: Pages VisaFlow can generate
generated.description: Built from the dossier data you entered. Nothing here contains a file — VisaFlow has never held one.
generated.coverSheetHint: Applicant, destination, application type and dates on one page.
generated.submissionChecklistHint: The list above, as a page you can tick off.
generated.appointmentSummaryHint: Date, time, location and confirmation number.
generated.itinerarySummaryHint: Travel dates and your recorded route.

physical.title: Your physical dossier
physical.description: Documents that come from your own files. VisaFlow only tracks whether you have them — it never stores, uploads or prints them.

print.actionHint: Opens a printable version in this tab. Use your browser's Print dialog to print it or save it as a PDF.

surface.heading: Appointment package
surface.lead: Prepared from the dossier information you recorded. Check it over before you print.
surface.disclaimer: Preparation material only. This is not an official visa form, and no embassy or visa centre requires it. Always verify requirements using current official sources.
surface.partial: Some of this is not recorded yet, and is left blank rather than guessed.
surface.empty: There is no dossier open, so there is nothing to print.
surface.checklistNote: Tick each item as you put it in the folder.

looksGood.title: What already looks good
looksGood.description: Areas that are on file and currently raise nothing.

disclaimer: VisaFlow organises the information you entered. It does not submit your application and does not predict whether a visa will be granted. Always confirm requirements with the official consulate or visa centre.

departure.title: Before you leave
departure.description: A short check you can run on your phone on the way out the door.
departure.bundlesHint: Your own documents. VisaFlow only tracks whether you have them — it never holds them.
departure.bundlesEmpty: No documents in your dossier yet.
departure.sheetsHint: Built from what you entered. Printing is not built yet.
departure.attentionUnconfirmed_one: {{count}} document is in hand but not confirmed ready
departure.attentionUnconfirmed_other: {{count}} documents are in hand but not confirmed ready
departure.attentionNone: Nothing is waiting for your attention
departure.footer: Use this as your final folder check.

journey.title: Journey
journey.description: How you get there, where you stay, and why you are going — exactly as you recorded it.
